title: Conventional Loans
tagline: Flexible terms for borrowers with strong credit profiles.
overview: Conventional mortgages give you predictable payments and the freedom to choose from fixed or adjustable-rate structures.
They work well when you have established credit history and the ability to make a down payment of at least 3%.
features: Loan amounts up to conforming limits with competitive interest rates
Option to remove private mortgage insurance once the loan reaches 80% loan-to-value
Available in a variety of fixed and adjustable-rate terms
Use for primary residences, vacation homes, or investment properties
idealFor: Borrowers with credit scores of 620+
Homebuyers who have saved for a down payment
Clients who want predictable monthly payments

title: FHA Loans
tagline: Government-backed financing with low down payment options.
overview: The FHA program opens the door to homeownership with flexible credit requirements and down payments as low as 3.5%.
Insurance premiums help protect the lender so you can qualify with a modest credit profile.
features: Lower credit score requirements compared to conventional programs
Down payments starting at 3.5%
Streamlined refinance options for existing FHA borrowers
Gift funds and down payment assistance programs permitted
idealFor: First-time buyers building their credit history
Borrowers seeking flexible underwriting
Clients who plan to stay in their home long-term

title: VA Loans
tagline: Zero-down home financing for eligible veterans and service members.
overview: VA loans are backed by the Department of Veterans Affairs and offer unmatched benefits for those who have served.
Enjoy 0% down payment options and no private mortgage insurance requirements.
features: 100% financing available for eligible veterans and active-duty personnel
No monthly mortgage insurance premium
Flexible credit and debt-to-income guidelines
Assumable loan options for future buyers
idealFor: Active-duty service members and veterans
Military families relocating or purchasing their first home
Borrowers looking to refinance an existing VA loan

title: USDA Loans
tagline: Affordable financing for eligible rural and suburban properties.
overview: The USDA Guaranteed Loan Program extends zero-down payment financing to qualifying rural areas.
Income limits and property eligibility ensure the program supports growing communities.
features: 0% down payment for approved properties
Competitive fixed interest rates
Flexible credit guidelines
Low monthly mortgage insurance premiums
idealFor: Borrowers looking outside major metropolitan areas
Low-to-moderate income households
Buyers seeking affordable monthly payments

title: Jumbo Loans
tagline: High-balance mortgages tailored for luxury and high-cost markets.
overview: When your purchase price exceeds conforming loan limits, a jumbo mortgage keeps your financing streamlined.
Competitive rates and flexible structures allow you to tailor payments for your portfolio.
features: Loan amounts above conforming limits
Fixed or adjustable-rate options
Interest-only payment structures available for qualified borrowers
Financing available for primary, secondary, and investment properties
idealFor: High-net-worth borrowers purchasing premium properties
Homebuyers in competitive coastal or urban markets
Clients integrating multiple assets into their financing strategy

title: HELOC (Home Equity)
tagline: Tap into your home equity with revolving credit when you need it.
overview: A home equity line of credit lets you borrow, repay, and borrow again using the equity you have built.
Use funds for renovations, debt consolidation, or strategic investments.
features: Interest-only payments during the draw period
Access only the funds you need, when you need them
Competitive variable rates tied to prime indices
Flexible repayment terms after the draw period
idealFor: Homeowners with significant equity
Borrowers planning renovations or upgrades
Clients who want a safety net for future expenses

title: Rehab & Investment Property Loans
tagline: Short-term and long-term financing designed for property investors.
overview: From renovation loans to long-term rental financing, we help investors close quickly and confidently.
Pair acquisition and rehab funds or lock in 30-year rental terms once the property is stabilized.
features: Fix-and-flip financing with draws for renovation budgets
Bridge loans for fast closings and competitive markets
Rental DSCR programs with cash-flow-based underwriting
Financing options for single-family, multifamily, and mixed-use assets
idealFor: Investors renovating distressed properties
Landlords growing rental portfolios
Clients seeking to refinance into long-term debt after rehab

title: Zero Down Payment Options
tagline: Pair lender programs with assistance funds to minimize upfront costs.
overview: Down payment assistance programs combine grants, second mortgages, and lender credits to make buying easier.
We guide you through eligibility requirements and coordinate with approved partners.
features: Access to state and local down payment assistance funds
Lender credits to offset closing costs
First-time buyer education to simplify the process
Works with FHA, VA, USDA, and conventional structures
idealFor: First-time buyers with strong income but limited savings
Borrowers leveraging community development programs
Clients planning to occupy their new home as a primary residence

title: Self-Employed Borrower Programs
tagline: Alternative documentation solutions for entrepreneurs and gig workers.
overview: Traditional income verification can overlook true earning power. Our self-employed programs evaluate cash flow holistically.
Bank statement, CPA-prepared, and asset utilization options help you qualify without stress.
features: 12- or 24-month bank statement averaging for income calculations
CPA letters and profit-and-loss statements accepted
Higher debt-to-income ratios accommodated
Financing available for primary, second, and investment properties
idealFor: Business owners with variable monthly income
Freelancers and gig-economy professionals
Borrowers with significant liquid assets
